detail.title: Resolution of Invalid Measurement in Value Divergence Experiments
detail.summary: This cycle addresses the persistent invalid_measurement results for experiment ID exp-divergent-values-test-143 by revising the core hypothesis to target the instrument's validation sensitivity. The new hypothesis shifts focus from variance isolation to structured input compliance, proposing that the instrument requires more complex observational data to validate the measurements.
